name: Illustrative North Parking Garage

accessPoints.label: Southeast stairwell and lift, ground level

vehicleEntrances.label: Vehicle entrance from the north side street

rules.enforcementNote: The mandatory catch-all at rules[0]. It states the honest default for this garage: outside enforcement hours anyone may park, no permit. Every rule below is an exception layered on top, and because this rule covers all seven days with no date bounds, no instant is ever left without an answer.

Shadows the base rule during the enforced weekday window. Patrolled through the morning; a citation is issued rather than a warning, and the posted signage at the vehicle entrance is the authority if it disagrees with the published map.

A WRAPPING window: the end is earlier than the start, so it runs 22:00 to midnight and on to 06:00 the following morning. Under the previous no-wrap rule this needed two separate entries and it was easy to get the second one wrong. daysOfWeek names the nights the window OPENS on, not the mornings it spills into.

Home football Saturday: reserved for permit holders, towed otherwise. It sits LAST, so on that one date it shadows everything above it without any of those rules being edited. Ordering replaced the old integer priority field; array position cannot tie the way two equal priorities could.

capacity.fillNote: Fills from the lower decks up. Arriving after the 09:30 class change usually means the top deck or nothing.

notes: ILLUSTRATIVE PLACEHOLDER RECORD. This garage does not exist. The rule windows, permit classes, capacity, and game-day override are invented to demonstrate the ordered last-match-wins rule model, the mandatory catch-all base rule, and a window that wraps past midnight. Replace with verified FSU Transportation and Parking Services data before shipping.
